name: @payswap/onchain-venues
description: Onchain execution-venue extension packs (Work Order P4-W2-002): independent DEX/aggregator/intent venues modelled as capability packs BUILT ON @payswap/onchain-domain (ProtocolDefinition/ProtocolImplementation/ConnectedProtocolInstance composing the canonical INV-SC01 SmartContractExtension) and registered behind @payswap/best-execution's neutral ExecutionVenue port. The reference venue extension (uniswap), an independent 0x-style aggregator venue (its own extension pack — RFQ + AMM source aggregation with provider-native smart routing as the incumbent baseline), and an intent/solver-oriented venue (batch-auction settlement, solver competition) are SUBPATH exports so the core barrel stays venue-neutral (dependency direction: venue → core). Venue-specific shapes (router calldata encoding, RFQ source composition, intent payloads) live in the venue pack files — never in any core contract.
